topic.title: Topic / Premise
topic.description: The story premise, theme, or concept to build the story around.

language.title: Language
language.description: Output language. Use 'en' for English or 'th' for Thai.

genre.title: Genre
genre.description: The story genre. Determines tone, vocabulary, and narrative conventions.

mood.title: Mood
mood.description: The emotional atmosphere of the story.

target_audience.title: Target Audience
target_audience.description: Describe the intended audience for the article.

include_dialogue.title: Include Dialogue
include_dialogue.description: Whether to include character dialogue in the story.

word_count.title: Maximum words (optional)
word_count.description: If provided, the story must not exceed this word count. Overrides length preset.

reference_images.title: Reference Images
reference_images.description: Optional array of reference image URLs. When provided, the story should weave visual elements from these images into the narrative.

response_mode.title: Response Mode
response_mode.description: Choose 'markdown' for readable text or 'cms_json' for structured CMS output.
